scope: Unresolved dependencies and optional opportunities for follow-up. These leads are not current product requirements and, unless a source ID is given, were not investigated as evidence in this stage.

unresolved.question: Can the selected Napari 0.9.2, Zarr-Python 3.4.0 and OME-NGFF 0.5 stack open the same representative arrays lazily and preserve axes, units, multiscale and transforms?
unresolved.next_step: Build a small compatibility spike with pinned dependencies and asymmetric 2D/3D/5D fixtures before committing the stack.
unresolved.decision_impact: If bounded reads or metadata fidelity fail, choose a different adapter or defer the affected format/view mode.

unresolved.topic: Project coordinate matrix convention and non-scale/translation calibration
unresolved.question: Which canonical vector/axis order, handedness, origin, unit normalization and affine extension will the project schema use for source formats whose orientation exceeds NGFF scale/translation?
unresolved.next_step: Write a schema example for anisotropic and oblique data, then verify forward/inverse mappings through annotation save/reopen/export.
unresolved.decision_impact: Required before storing geometry or claiming physical-coordinate export fidelity.

unresolved.topic: 3 GB bounded-read budget and latency target
unresolved.question: What shapes, sample types, compression, channels, time points and access patterns represent the group's largest data, and what latency/RSS thresholds count as responsive?
unresolved.next_step: Select one representative 3 GB sample and agree measurable thresholds before benchmarking on 8-core/16 GB hardware.
unresolved.decision_impact: Determines chunk size, pyramid generation, cache budget, worker count and whether each reader stays in support.

unresolved.topic: Project identity for directory stores and source relocation
unresolved.question: How should the importer create a reproducible content identity for a Zarr directory while files may change during hashing or live in a large shared store?
unresolved.next_step: Specify deterministic manifest hashing, snapshot consistency and relink rules; test modification during scan and after registration.
unresolved.decision_impact: Affects safe relocation, duplicate detection and whether an annotation can be asserted to target the same image.

unresolved.topic: Shared storage durability and atomic publication
unresolved.question: Which filesystem/share providers are actually used, and what are their rename, flush, locking and interruption guarantees?
unresolved.next_step: Test staged publication and copy/verify bundle transfer on each intended provider; keep editing local if live share semantics are uncertain.
unresolved.decision_impact: Determines whether atomic rename can be used there or whether only local snapshot creation plus verified copying is supported.

unresolved.topic: Bundle size, original data rights and relocation needs
unresolved.question: Can project bundles include source files or only derived data and references, and what storage/retention limits apply?
unresolved.next_step: Agree with the group whether the portable default bundles originals, a converted immutable copy, or checksummed references.
unresolved.decision_impact: Sets portability versus storage cost and the user-visible meaning of an external-source bundle.

optional.why_useful: A mature microscopy reader/plugin ecosystem may extend instrument coverage sooner than maintaining bespoke adapters.
optional.why_not_adopted_yet: No format-by-format bounded-read, axis/calibration, licensing, provenance or export behavior was checked in this diagnostic. Reader breadth alone does not prove project-level identity and recovery behavior.
optional.next_step: Choose one representative vendor dataset and compare a Bio-Formats/Fiji route with the proposed NGFF adapter, including exact series selection and exported-coordinate round trip.
optional.evidence_status: Candidate lead only; not captured or evaluated as a source in this stage.

optional.why_useful: Could provide a smaller, maintainable allowlist path for a tested TIFF subset without claiming universal vendor-format support.
optional.why_not_adopted_yet: No source capture or bounded-read benchmark was performed; compression, strips/tiles, metadata variants and volumes can change memory behavior.
optional.next_step: Evaluate exact version-pinned readers on representative tiled, stripped and compressed fixtures; admit only those with measured regional reads and preserved calibration.
optional.evidence_status: Candidate lead only; not captured or evaluated as a source in this stage.

optional.why_useful: A later check of the standard's labels/ROI conventions may make mask or region exchange more interoperable than a project-only format.
optional.why_not_adopted_yet: This stage used NGFF image axes/transforms as its evidence; it did not establish all label/ROI semantics or round-trip behavior.
optional.next_step: Review the exact pinned specification and implementation/test history for label/ROI semantics, then verify annotation scope, axis order and calibration survive export/import.
optional.evidence_status: Lead informed by S1; detailed label/ROI behavior not validated.

optional.topic: Automated segmentation as a derived-mask producer
optional.why_useful: Could reduce repeated manual tracing for suitable datasets while keeping model output inspectable as a separate annotation/derived asset.
optional.why_not_adopted_yet: Not a minimum obligation; requires model/version, input hash, parameters, uncertainty, human review and reproducibility records. No segmentation component was investigated or run.
optional.next_step: If researchers request it, prototype one optional tool that writes a separate versioned mask and never edits source pixels or silently replaces manual annotations.
optional.evidence_status: Product opportunity only; no source-backed implementation claim.

optional.why_useful: Could help if exchanged immutable bundles and parent-generation conflict detection prove insufficient.
optional.why_not_adopted_yet: The brief calls for ordinary shared-storage bundle exchange; live multi-user editing, identity, service operations and conflict semantics would expand the first release substantially.
optional.next_step: Collect concrete bundle-conflict cases first; revisit only if local versioned snapshots cannot resolve them safely.
optional.evidence_status: Product alternative only; no service was investigated.

optional.why_useful: Could reduce storage-object count for many small chunks.
optional.why_not_adopted_yet: Zarr-Python docs note shard writes require reading the full shard and can create concurrency issues; no workload benefit or write penalty was benchmarked.
optional.next_step: Consider only after measuring ordinary chunk storage on representative reads/writes and adding interruption/concurrency tests.
optional.evidence_status: Mechanism and tradeoff documented at S3; adoption deferred.
